fields.label: Sales Invoice
fields.description: The ERPNext SI mirroring this EE shipment. Populated at SI creation time by the b2c invoice_builder / credit_note builder. One shipment row per SI.

fields.label: Event Type
fields.description: Synthesised from EE order_status + invoice_number presence, matching EE tax export Invoice Status column: Sold (Shipped/Confirmed/Manifest Scanned/Returned with a Credit Note pair), Sold(cancelled) (Cancelled after invoicing), Returned (post-manifest return with paired CN), RTO (returned-to-origin). Blank on Draft/pending SIs before terminal state resolves.

fields.label: Original Sales Invoice
fields.description: For Credit Note / Sales Return rows: the SI they reverse. Enables recon to net Forward (SI) against Reverse (CN) at order grain per RECON_SPEC §6.4. Null on original SIs (only populated on CN/SR shipment rows).

fields.label: EE Invoice ID (numeric)
fields.description: EE's internal numeric invoice_id (data.orders[].invoice_id). Used by getAllOrders lookups. Distinct from invoice_number (which is the human-readable alphanumeric).

fields.label: EE Invoice Number
fields.description: EE's alphanumeric invoice number (e.g. BHR52627-489, CHR62627-10167). Appears on the tax invoice PDF and in EE's tax export CSV EE Invoice No column. Primary reconciliation key against EE tax export.

fields.label: EE Invoice PDF URL
fields.description: S3 URL of the tax invoice PDF hosted by EE (documents.easyecom_invoice from getAllOrders). Small Text so URL length is unbounded and off-row storage.

fields.label: Batch ID
fields.description: EE's manifest batch identifier (batch_id from getAllOrders). Orders manifested together share a batch. Useful for correlating dispatch waves.

fields.label: Batch Created At
fields.description: When EE created the manifest batch (batch_created_at from getAllOrders). Distinct from manifest_date — batch_created_at is the operational grouping timestamp; manifest_date is when this specific shipment was marked manifested.

fields.label: Sales Channel
fields.description: EE Sales Channel value (Marketplace B2C / Sample / ECOM / Offline GT / IIA / Offline MT / blank). Distinct from marketplace — same marketplace can have multiple sales channels (e.g. Shopify main vs Sample vs ECOM).

fields.label: Manifest Date
fields.description: When EE marked the shipment as manifested (goods physically left the warehouse). Blank means the shipment is pending manifest — SI stays in Draft until this populates.

fields.label: Manifest No
fields.description: LR / manifest document number (manifest_no from getAllOrders). Populated when a physical LR is printed (B2B / bulk shipments). Rarely populated for retail marketplace shipments.

fields.label: AWB Number
fields.description: Airway Bill / tracking number from the carrier (awb_number from getAllOrders).

fields.label: Courier
fields.description: Courier partner name (courier from getAllOrders — e.g. Delhivery, SelfShip, Bluedart).

fields.label: Invoice Currency Code
fields.description: ISO currency code from getAllOrders (invoice_currency_code). For export invoices this will be SGD / CAD / NPR / USD etc. total_amount_native + conversion_rate reconcile back to INR-denominated SI.grand_total. Non-INR shipments must have conversion_rate populated or the SI must use ERPNext multi-currency (currency + conversion_rate on SI itself).

fields.label: Conversion Rate to INR
fields.description: Native currency → INR conversion rate. 1.0 when invoice_currency_code = INR. For foreign currency invoices, sourced from EE's tax export (when EE adds the field to getAllOrders response) or from ERPNext Currency Exchange DocType keyed by (from_currency, to_currency=INR, exchange_date=invoice_date). total_amount_native × conversion_rate = SI.base_grand_total.

fields.label: Conversion Rate Confirmed by Ops
fields.description: For non-INR invoices, ops must verify the conversion_rate against EE's tax export / their portal before the pending-manifest sweeper submits the SI. Auto-set to 1 for INR invoices (no verification needed). Prevents FX-rate drift between our Currency Exchange DocType and EE's locked-in rate — the pattern until EE adds conversion_rate to the getAllOrders API response.

fields.label: Conversion Rate Source
fields.options:
ERPNext Currency Exchange
EE Tax Export (manual)
EE API (native)
Manual override
fields.description: Provenance of the conversion_rate field. Set at SI creation time by the builder. 'ERPNext Currency Exchange' is the default source until EE adds conversion_rate to getAllOrders — then flips to 'EE API (native)' and confirmation becomes automatic.

fields.label: Total Amount (Native Currency)
fields.description: getAllOrders total_amount as returned — in invoice_currency_code, NOT INR. Preserved verbatim for audit / recon against EE tax export. INR equivalent lives on SI.base_grand_total after multi-currency conversion.

fields.label: Total Tax (Native Currency)
fields.description: getAllOrders total_tax as returned. Foreign-currency exports are typically 0-tax (zero-rated under §16(1)(a) IGST Act).

fields.label: Payment Gateway Name
fields.description: Payment gateway name from getAllOrders (e.g. Gokwik UPI, Gokwik Wallets, Gokwik Cards, Stripe, Razorpay). Populated on Prepaid orders where the marketplace routed payment through a gateway.

fields.label: Payment Gateway Transaction Number
fields.description: Gateway-issued transaction reference. Enables payment reconciliation against bank / PSP statements independent of marketplace payout reports.

fields.label: GST Compliance Cross-references
fields.description: Values as REPORTED BY EE. Cross-check against India Compliance's E-Invoice Log / E-Waybill Log for the same SI — divergence signals that EE and IC generated different IRNs / e-way bills for the same invoice.

fields.label: IRN (from EE)
fields.description: Invoice Reference Number as reported by EE. Compare against India Compliance E-Invoice Log for the same SI to detect divergence.

fields.label: IRN Acknowledgement Number
fields.description: GSTN acknowledgement number (ack_no) paired with the IRN.

fields.label: IRN Acknowledgement Date
fields.description: GSTN acknowledgement timestamp (ack_dt).

fields.label: E-Way Bill Number
fields.description: E-way bill number as reported by EE. Compare against India Compliance E-Waybill Log for the same SI.

fields.label: E-Way Bill Date
fields.description: E-way bill generation timestamp.
